domain: SEC filing-clock aggregate fundamentals: aggregate cash-intensity (liquidity-margin) LEVEL of the sector filer panel, aggregated point-in-time through the canonical bridge (research/assets/stocks/pit_conditioning.py); PIT-conditioned proposal (contributes to the >=3-of-6 quota; no price-derived conditioning claim)
title: Aggregate cash-intensity level as a liquidity-risk compensation state for sector ETFs: long cash-light sector filer panels, short cash-heavy ones, market-neutral, on the frozen 12-ETF cohort
mechanism_question: Does the LEVEL of aggregate cash intensity - the point-in-time equal-weight sector mean of cash-and-equivalents scaled by the sector mean of total assets, both built from SEC instant facts - transmit to sector-ETF forward returns as a liquidity-risk compensation differential? Concretely: do sectors whose filer panels hold little cash relative to assets (riskier, levered-deployment balance sheets) outperform sectors whose panels are cash-heavy (defensive, liquidity-buffered balance sheets) after SPY/sector beta is removed and after 10 bps/side costs? The mechanism is deliberately a STOCK (liquidity intensity of the financing side), mechanistically distinct from A4-H1's REAL-side investment FLOW (balance-sheet expansion velocity of us-gaap:Assets): different primary field family (cash + current assets vs. assets), different economic channel (risk-premium scaling of liquidity buffers vs. discount-rate dynamics of investment), different ranking axis (scaling vs. differencing).
falsifiable_prediction: Directional and specific, preregistered with no sign rescue: the cross-sectional relation between aggregate cash intensity CI_i(t) = M_cash,i(t)/M_assets,i(t) and forward sector-ETF excess returns is NEGATIVE (Palazzo liquidity-compensation direction). Operationally, the anchor book (long the 3 lowest-CI eligible sectors, short the 3 highest-CI, hysteresis 3+3, +/-1/6 per leg, quarterly 63-session clock, net ~ 0) must show, over S0 2018-04-04..2025-07-31 with 3 frozen folds: (i) after-cost expectancy > 0 at 10 bps/side; (ii) position PF >= 1.10; (iii) at least 2/3 folds positive; (iv) MDD <= 15%; (v) positive incremental alpha versus the frozen risk-matched SPY context overall AND risk-matched excess positive in at least 2/3 folds; (vi) the raw-cash-LEVEL control must NOT reproduce the result under its preregistered rule (|control incremental alpha| < 0.5 x |anchor incremental alpha| and control expectancy <= 0), and a control that outperforms a negative anchor falsifies the family outright (V2/V4 lesson, L6). The competing reading is preregistered as the falsification hypothesis: Simutin (2010) finds high cash predicts HIGHER returns (cash as growth-option proxy). If the realized sign is that of Simutin - cash-heavy sectors outperform - the anchor loses and this family is rejected as specified; the Simutin reading is a different family and is not proposed here.
literature: Palazzo, B. (2012), 'Cash Holdings, Risk, and Expected Returns', Journal of Financial Economics 104(1): 123-141 - firms with high cash-to-assets earn LOWER subsequent returns: cash de-levers the equity, lowers its risk, and the market prices the liquidity margin as lower required compensation. This is the preregistered direction of the anchor.

Simutin, M. (2010), 'Excess Cash and Stock Returns', Financial Management 39(3): 1197-1222 - the opposing finding: high excess cash predicts HIGHER returns because cash proxies for unobserved growth options. Declared ex ante as this family's falsification sign-hypothesis; a realized positive relation for cash-heavy sectors rejects the preregistered family without sign rescue.

Acharya, V., Almeida, H. and Campello, M. (2007), 'Is Cash Negative Debt? A Hedging Perspective on Corporate Financial Policies', Journal of Financial Intermediation 16(4): 515-542 - cash is a hedging liquidity margin whose valuation role depends on the firm's access to external finance; grounds the risk-side interpretation of the cash stock that the compensation channel uses.

Bates, T., Kahle, K. and Stulz, R. (2009), 'Why Do U.S. Firms Hold So Much More Cash than They Used To?', Journal of Finance 64(5): 1985-2021 - documents that aggregate cash-to-assets moved materially across the sample era and is a genuine balance-sheet state, not a statistical artifact; supports treating the sector cash ratio as a persistent conditioning quantity.

No other aggregation path is authorized; no fundamental quantity is derived from OHLCV (plan 6.P2 no-proxy rule).

Coverage census (packet, pre-S0 availability fraction, floor 0.80): XLB 0.975, XLC 0.80, XLE 0.80, XLF 0.70 (FAILS - XLF is NOT fundable for this field and is excluded from ranks, FLAT at every tick, declared ex ante as an availability rule with the census numbers quoted), XLI 1.00, XLK 0.90, XLP 1.00, XLRE 1.00, XLU 0.975, XLV 0.925, XLY 0.975 - fundable in 10/11 sectors.

us-gaap:Assets - denominator field of the anchor key. Coverage census: XLB 0.975, XLC 0.85, XLE 0.80, XLF 0.90, XLI 1.00, XLK 0.90, XLP 1.00, XLRE 1.00, XLU 1.00, XLV 0.925, XLY 0.975 - fundable in 11/11 sectors. Used ONLY as the scaling convention of the liquidity-intensity object; the mechanism field of this family is the cash family (this field is the mechanism field of A4-H1, a different family).
pit_observable_with_availability_semanti.fields_not_used_pit: dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding and us-gaap:CommonStockSharesIssued are deliberately NOT used anywhere in this proposal (raw cover-page share counts are split-unadjusted; an issuance-flow key would be contaminated by split events that the bridge does not adjust for - rejected at design time, before any scoring); dei:EntityPublicFloat (price-contaminated quantity; a float-velocity key would smuggle in a price-momentum proxy); us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent (census-fundable in only 2/11 sectors); all duration facts; any OHLCV-derived fundamental proxy (forbidden); FRED/ALFRED, FINRA, Alpha Vantage, ECB, BIS (BLOCKED/out-of-scope, fail closed).
pit_observable_with_availability_semanti.availability_semantics: SEC filed dates are date-only: availability is stamped at the END of the filed UTC day (conservative upper bound; retrieval time never substitutes). A record influences decisions no earlier than its availability stamp plus one session, implemented exactly by pit_conditioning.session_gate_utc: a row is usable for decision session S iff available_time_utc < 00:00 UTC of S. Re-filed values supersede strictly after their own availability (fusion select_asof), never retroactively. PIT regression pin: tests/assets/stocks/test_pit_conditioning_adoption.py mutates availability stamps and must observe invisibility of any row at or after the gate.
pit_observable_with_availability_semanti.aggregate_construction: M_cash,i(t) and M_assets,i(t) are each single-vintage equal-weight means over the sector-i filers INCLUDED at t for the respective field, computed by aggregate_sector_asof with sorted entity order and math.fsum. The ratio of means (not the mean of filer-level ratios) is the DECLARED statistic - the bridge aggregates one field at a time; the construction is deterministic and identical across arms. SectorObservation.coverage = filers_included/filers_mapped is reported per observation and per field.
pit_observable_with_availability_semanti.anchor_key: CI_i(t) = M_cash,i(t) / M_assets,i(t) - the aggregate cash-intensity LEVEL at t. This is a stock; it has no differencing span and no price input anywhere.
pit_observable_with_availability_semanti.eligibility_gates_frozen: (a) sector pre-S0 fundability per census >= 0.80 for BOTH fields: XLF fails the cash numerator (0.70) and is permanently rank-ineligible/FLAT; the other 10 sectors pass; (b) at every tick, BOTH field observations must have coverage >= 0.60 (thin filing-season vintages are unaggregated data, not signal - the gate makes them FLAT instead); (c) effective-date coherence: if M_cash,i and M_assets,i at t rest on effective dates more than 100 calendar days apart, the sector is ineligible at that tick (asymmetric filer reporting); (d) the ETF leg requires >= 63 sessions of authorized adjusted-close history through t (XLC's 2018-06-19 inception delays its first leg eligibility to ~2018-09; before that XLC is held FLAT - an availability rule, not a selection). The cross-section is never emptied by construction (>= 9 sectors eligible at every tick).
pit_observable_with_availability_semanti.warmup: first S0 decision tick 2018-04-04 requires gated cash and assets aggregates at t (pre-S0 availability certified by the census fractions above) plus 252 sessions of pre-S0 price runway for the kappa_t beta regression, identical to V4 warmup practice. No scored computation reads any session after 2025-07-31.

aggregation_declaration.binding_rule: per d1_proposal_packet binding_rules.aggregation_declaration: the following are frozen ex ante at family freeze and are NEVER tuned after scored PnL is visible.
aggregation_declaration.max_filing_gap_days_rationale: 400 days (~13.3 months) exceeds the 12-month filing cycle: annual-only 10-K filers keep contributing between their annual stamps, quarterly filers trivially stay in, and a filer that stops filing drops out of the participating set about one quarter after its last availability stamp. Survivorship is governed by the explicit PIT filing-clock rule of the bridge, never by silent panel trimming; the parameter is constant across all three arms of this family, across A4-H1, and across all V5 families of this agent.
aggregation_declaration.aggregation_statistic: ratio of single-vintage equal-weight means over sorted filers (math.fsum), exactly as returned by aggregate_sector_asof per field; no winsorizing, no size weighting, no vintage blending, no per-filer ratio averaging.
aggregation_declaration.key_transform: anchor key CI_i(t) = M_cash,i(t)/M_assets,i(t); neighbour key CURR_i(t) = M_cash,i(t)/M_current,i(t); control key ln(M_cash,i(t)); no smoothing, no rank averaging across ticks.

universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.universe: frozen 12-ETF cohort (SPY + XLB, XLC, XLE, XLF, XLI, XLK, XLP, XLRE, XLU, XLV, XLY). SPY is reserved as benchmark context per the frozen benchmark contract and is NEVER a held leg. Decisions are taken on sector ETFs; conditioning comes from the SEC filer panel per sector via the canonical bridge. Rank-eligibility: 10 sectors (all but XLF, ex ante census rule above). Leg-eligibility is an availability rule only: >= 63 sessions of authorized {SYM}_all adjusted-close history through the decision session (delays XLC to ~2018-09; all other cohort ETFs eligible from S0 start).
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.warmup_sessions: pre-S0 PIT aggregate availability (census-certified) + 252-session pre-S0 price runway for the beta regression; first decision tick 2018-04-04 is already valid.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.decision_clock: quarterly session-count clock: every 63rd SPY session (252/4), RE-SEEDED at the first session of each frozen fold (S0_FOLD_1 2018-04-04..2020-09-01, S0_FOLD_2 2020-09-10..2023-02-09, S0_FOLD_3 2023-02-17..2025-07-24 per baseline_invariants.json). Ticks at fold-session offsets 0, 63, ..., 567: 10 ticks per fold (each fold has >= 599 sessions >= the 568 required), 30 scored decision periods total. Signals are computed at the tick on session-t PIT data only; force-flat and automaton re-seed at every fold boundary.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.holding_period: 63 sessions (one clock period); weights static between ticks; the book opened at offset 567 is force-flattened at the fold boundary (truncated hold is a scored decision per the frozen convention).
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.fill_clock: next allowed session after the decision close, open-adjacent close-to-close execution per baseline invariants (V3 ADJ-1-EXEC-CLOCK); no same-session fill ever.

anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.anchor: SFV5-A4-H2-ANCHOR (CASHINT-L3S3-63), exact rule, no parameter menu: (1) build M_cash,i(t) and M_assets,i(t) for all 11 sectors from the two PIT panels per the frozen aggregation declaration; compute CI_i(t) = M_cash,i(t)/M_assets,i(t); apply the frozen eligibility gates (10-sector rank set). (2) Rank eligible sectors by CI DESCENDING (rank 1 = most cash-heavy, rank N = most cash-light); ties broken lexicographically by symbol. (3) Hysteresis book automaton (same deterministic shape as the V4 SFV4-A4-H1 anchor, K = 3): seed at each fold's first tick - LONG := ranks N-2..N (the 3 most cash-light), SHORT := ranks 1..3 (the 3 most cash-heavy); subsequent ticks, applied in fixed order: (i) exits - a LONG whose new rank <= N-4 leaves LONG (to SHORT if its new rank <= 3 and |SHORT| < 3, else FLAT); a SHORT whose new rank >= 5 leaves SHORT (to LONG if its new rank >= N-2 and |LONG| < 3, else FLAT); (ii) entries - FLAT sectors with rank >= N-2 enter LONG in ascending-CI order while |LONG| < 3; FLAT sectors with rank <= 3 enter SHORT in descending-CI order while |SHORT| < 3; ties lexicographic. (4) Weights: +1/6 per LONG leg, -1/6 per SHORT leg (weights +/-1/(2K) if K ever degenerates below 3 under the frozen floor rule K = min(3, floor(N/3)), N = eligible count >= 9 here); CASH absorbs residual; gross <= 1.0, net ~ 0; long/short books accounted separately per baseline invariants; weights static between ticks. This is the single primary arm; the 3+3 baskets, band <= K+1 / > N-K-1, cash/assets scaling, 63-session clock and 1/6 weights are fixed ex ante with no alternatives offered.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.neighbour: SFV5-A4-H2-NEIGH (CURRINT-L3S3-63), one fixed variant supporting the same mechanism: identical to the anchor in every element (hysteresis automaton, weights, clock, holding, fills, costs, accounting) except the scaling denominator is the current-asset aggregate: CURR_i(t) = M_cash,i(t)/M_current,i(t) with M_current,i from us-gaap:AssetsCurrent (census: fundable in 9/11 sectors - XLF 0.25 and XLRE 0.20 fail the 0.80 floor; the neighbour's rank set is the 9 sectors passing both numerator and denominator gates). Mechanism-support logic: the compensation channel attaches to liquidity INTENSITY as such - the stricter current-liquidity scaling is a materially different construction of the same object; agreement of both scalings supports the mechanism while disagreement marks the anchor as denominator-specific. The 9-vs-10 sector universe difference between neighbour and anchor is a declared availability consequence of the frozen census, not a selection choice. No other variant is proposed.

causal_negative_control.control: SFV5-A4-H2-CTRL (CASHLEVEL-L3S3-63): identical surface form to the anchor - same clock, same N handling, same rank-and-hysteresis 3+3 book at +/-1/6, same holding, fills, costs, risk-match and neutralization - but the ranking key is the LOG LEVEL of the raw cash aggregate alone, ln(M_cash,i(t)): LONG the 3 smallest absolute cash holders, SHORT the 3 largest. The control is the numerator of the anchor key with the scaling information deleted: not a different variable but the orthogonal transformation of the SAME variable, which is what makes the identification causal rather than cosmetic.
causal_negative_control.why_cannot_reproduce_mechanism: The preregistered mechanism (Palazzo; Acharya-Almeida-Campello) prices cash INTENSITY - the liquidity margin relative to the scale of the balance sheet - not absolute cash. rank(M_cash/M_assets) is not a function of rank(M_cash): two panels with identical cash orderings but different asset-scale structures produce byte-identical control books and different anchor books. Absolute-cash ranks are dominated by filer-panel scale composition (which sectors happen to contain large-cash filers), carrying no intensity information; a monotone common rescaling of every sector's assets leaves the control key untouched while reshuffling anchor ranks at will. Under its preregistered rule the control can carry only a scale artifact; if it nevertheless reproduces the anchor's spread, the claimed liquidity-compensation mechanism is falsified and the spread belongs to a size axis.
causal_negative_control.why_not_the_L7_trap: L7 (V4): controls died pre-selection at measured control self-subsumption rho 0.78-0.83 because stale ranks of persistent states are rank-identical to their anchors. A one-tick-stale or four-tick-stale cash-intensity control is exactly that trap - CI is highly persistent - and is PROHIBITED as this family's control. The numerator-only control is the scaling-inverse of the anchor, not a lagged copy: lag correlation of the intensity ratio is near one by persistence, while numerator-vs-ratio rank correlation is structurally unconstrained and empirically weakened by the order-of-magnitude cross-sector differences in the assets denominator.
causal_negative_control.control_can_fire: The control is a live rule, not a stub: ln(M_cash,i) has strictly positive cross-sectional dispersion at every tick and fills 3+3 baskets at every tick (N >= 9); it trades through the same hysteresis automaton and incurs the same costs. A control that cannot fire identifies nothing; this one can.
causal_negative_control.preregistered_falsification_rule: The anchor passes only if |control risk-matched incremental alpha| < 0.5 x |anchor risk-matched incremental alpha| (frozen gate control_alpha_abs_ratio_lt = 0.5) AND control expectancy <= 0. If the control's expectancy > 0 with PF >= 1.0, or the ratio reaches 0.5, the spread is attributed to an absolute-cash scale effect, the family is REJECTED, and no alternate control may be substituted after results are seen.

anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.control_identifiability_verification_for: A9-F verifies identifiability from frozen inputs alone (PIT store sha f53eb371..., panel.json, frozen SPY calendar) by recomputing, WITHOUT any PnL or trading: (1) the anchor key and control key for all sectors at all 30 ticks; (2) Spearman rank correlation between anchor and control keys across eligible sectors at each tick - preregistered identifiability gate: mean |rho| over the 30 ticks <= 0.40 AND max |rho| <= 0.60 (V4 died at 0.78-0.83; a family above these bounds is control-subsumed and INELIGIBLE pre-selection); (3) CAN-FIRE: control cross-sectional dispersion > 0 at every tick AND at least 5 basket-membership changes of the control book across the 30 ticks (a control whose book never changes identifies nothing); (4) coverage-gate non-emptiness: >= 9 rank-eligible sectors at every tick for anchor and control, >= 8 for the neighbour. All four checks are deterministic rank arithmetic on declared PIT panels, reproducible from the store hash in seconds.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.novelty_guards_declared_ex_ante: Both A4-H1 and A4-H2 are new SEC-conditioned families; their pairwise and historical novelty is an A7-N measurement. Two guards are declared by the proposer, conservatively, before any data is scored: (a) CROSS-FAMILY: A7-N measures Spearman rank correlation between the H1 anchor key (asset-growth flow) and the H2 anchor key (cash-intensity level) across sectors at each tick; expectation and informal bound mean |rho| <= 0.60 - if the two anchor keys turn out rank-identical, the families collapse and at most one is eligible under the frozen rubric. (b) SHADOW-REGION: the H2 key is built exclusively from SEC aggregates and contains no price, return or volatility input; should the cash-intensity ordering incidentally mirror a volatility-level ordering, A7-N must measure the feature-rank correlation against the V4 vol-level control's variance-level feature and report it; a mean |rho| >= 0.60 would make this family a de facto vol-level re-entry and INELIGIBLE outside the Section 1.1 front door. The proposer claims no vol-level relationship and does not propose the Section 1.1 family.

incremental_alpha_test.risk_matched_incremental_alpha: Mandatory primary test per baseline invariants: incremental_alpha(arm, window) = R_arm(window) - R_spy_context(window), with R_spy_context = SPY total return (adjusted _all path, frozen benchmark contract) scaled EX ANTE by this arm's frozen rule, never realized gross re-applied after the fact. Frozen scaling rule (net ~ 0 book): kappa_t = clip(beta_hat_t, 0.0, 2.0), where beta_hat_t is the OLS slope of the arm's own daily book returns (a deterministic function of the frozen rule, hence PIT-computable at t) on SPY total-return daily returns over the trailing 252 sessions ending t-1; if fewer than 63 sessions of arm history exist at a tick, kappa_t := 0. Evaluated per fold AND overall; gates: anchor overall alpha > 0, risk-matched excess positive in >= 2/3 folds (frozen stage-A).
incremental_alpha_test.sector_factor_neutralization: All legs are sector ETFs, so the optional equal-weight sector factor (EW_SECTOR total return per the frozen benchmark contract) is used as a required secondary diagnostic: OLS of the arm's daily returns on [SPY total return, EW_SECTOR total return] per fold and overall; the annualized intercepts are reported alongside the primary metric. A result whose residual intercept after both-factor removal is not positive fails the mechanism claim regardless of raw PnL.
incremental_alpha_test.fail_closed: raw PnL, gross beta or long-equity exposure is never accepted as alpha (L6); every gate above fails closed per baseline invariants; a control that outperforms a negative anchor falsifies the family - and a positive raw PnL on a cash-light/cash-heavy spread is presumptively the sector-exposure form until the risk-match and neutralization tests say otherwise.

base_and_stress_costs.cost_model: 10 bps per side per fill at base; 20 bps per side per fill at stress; charged exactly once per fill (P1-A2 invariant 2, L2); benchmark paths uncosted per contract.
base_and_stress_costs.expected_base_drag: at the expected ~0.9-2.0 two-way turnover per year (point estimate ~1.4), base drag is ~9-20 bps/year (point ~14 bps); at stress ~18-40 bps/year (point ~28 bps). The annual-vintage persistence of balance-sheet ratios is the structural reason the arm can afford to be slow.
base_and_stress_costs.stress_rerun: full value-book rerun at 20 bps/side is part of the family's scored evidence; frozen gates: stress PnL > 0 and stress PF >= 1.0.

turnover_and_sample_floor.convention: turnover = sum(abs(delta_weight)) over non-CASH legs (frozen ADJ-5 convention, L3), reported annualized two-way, both raw and ceiling-normalized.
turnover_and_sample_floor.expected_turnover: 63-session quarterly clock: ~4.06 ticks/year. A cash-to-assets ratio is slower-moving than any flow statistic - sector CI ranks typically shift at annual-vintage horizons - so with hysteresis bands of width 1 the expected churn is 0.3-1.2 leg swaps per tick, each swap moving 2 x 1/6 = 1/3 of |delta w|: ~0.5-1.6 per year from rebalances, plus 3 force-flat boundary events over the 7.3-year S0 (1.0 each) ~ +0.41/year: expected ~0.9-2.0, point estimate ~1.4 two-way per year - 23% of the frozen 6.0 ceiling.
turnover_and_sample_floor.why_inside_ceiling: the design spends turnover only on genuine state transitions of a semiannual-to-annual fundamental ratio; hysteresis + ratio persistence + static weights between ticks structurally cap churn far below the ceiling with headroom for stress and boundary flattening. The honest worst case (full 3+3 reconstitution at every tick, ~8.0/year) breaches the ceiling BY DESIGN and would itself evidence that cash-intensity ranks carry no stable ordering - accepted as part of the falsification structure rather than loosened by a turncoat schedule.
turnover_and_sample_floor.sample_floor: 10 scored decision periods per fold x 3 folds = 30 per arm - the frozen floor (>= 30 total, >= 5 per fold) is met EXACTLY with ~6% session margin per fold (each fold needs >= 568 sessions for 10 ticks; folds have >= 599). Zero-margin honesty: if any tick were lost to degeneracy the arm fails the floor by arithmetic and dies in feasibility; no clock loosening is permitted. Positions: >= 6 non-CASH legs at every tick on the 10-sector anchor rank set (never fewer than 4 under the K = min(3, floor(N/3)) rule with N >= 9), satisfying the min-positions invariant.

drop_one_design.expected_max_concentration: 6 equal legs at 1/6 of gross each; ex ante no sector should dominate spread contributions. The honest hazard is a persistent single-sector relation - e.g., a structural cash-heavy outlier (large-cap technology inside XLK) or a cash-light commodity sector (XLE) dominating fold contributions and pushing one ETF's positive-PnL share above the frozen etf_positive_share_le = 0.35 gate; this is treated as a live hazard, not assumed away.
drop_one_design.drop_one_etf: full value-book rerun excluding the max-contribution symbol (frozen convention; the rank set shrinks by one, baskets and automaton unchanged); survival = after-drop expectancy > 0. Meaningful because the claim is a cross-sectional aggregate premium - it must not be one sector's episode. Declared asymmetry: dropping a leg from the 10-sector set leaves 9 eligible sectors and non-degenerate 3+3 baskets; this family never operates below 9 rank-eligible sectors by gate (a), so drop-one is always meaningful.
drop_one_design.drop_one_fold: min over folds of expectancy with that fold removed; survival = min > 0. Meaningful because the three folds span structurally distinct liquidity regimes - fold 1 holds the pre-COVID normalization and the 2020 cash-rush to safety (aggregate cash ratios spiked); fold 2 the 2020-2023 liquidity drawdown and inflation-era cash erosion; fold 3 the 2023-2025 cash-rebuild in concentrated large-cap technology - and a genuine liquidity-compensation premium must not be a single-regime artifact.
drop_one_design.caveat_declared_ex_ante: the 2020 cash spike makes fold 1 the natural home of any single-regime result; if the entire anchor expectancy is that episode, drop-one-fold fails by construction and the family is rejected - no fold re-weighting or exclusion is permitted.

failure_interpretation: A Stage-A reject means the aggregate cash-intensity level carries no exploitable after-cost, market-neutral information at sector-ETF granularity: the single-name liquidity-compensation anomaly (Palazzo) does not transmit to 10 large liquid sector composites, is absorbed by the absolute-cash scale axis (control fires), by SPY/sector-factor exposure (neutralization gate), or the sign follows Simutin's growth-option reading - in which case the preregistered family is rejected without sign rescue and the observed direction is recorded as evidence for the competing hypothesis, not rescued into a new family in this cycle. Sharper sub-cases: anchor negative with control negative = the liquidity axis is inert; anchor negative with control positive = raw PnL on this cohort is the cash-size/exposure form, not the mechanism (the exact V4 failure mode); anchor positive with control positive at ratio >= 0.5 = scale subsumption, mechanism falsified. Every outcome is terminal for this family in V5 - no window, basket, gate, scaling or clock tweak may be proposed to rescue it - and the verdict counts once in the historical denominator. A correct reject is a successful research run.
source_to_test_map: 1. Palazzo (2012) liquidity-compensation direction + Acharya-Almeida-Campello (2007) hedging-margin interpretation -> joint implication: high cash-to-assets predicts LOW forward returns -> implemented as the anchor key CI_i(t) = M_cash,i(t)/M_assets,i(t) built from the cash and assets PIT panels; feature goldens hand-computed in tests/assets/stocks/test_sec_aggregate_features.py against research/assets/stocks/sec_aggregate_features.py (to be written in the I phase from this frozen specification; shared with A4-H1's feature module).

2. Simutin (2010) growth-option reading -> declared falsification sign-hypothesis: a realized POSITIVE relation for cash-heavy sectors rejects the family without sign rescue -> the negative-side seed rule of the anchor (SHORT := highest CI) is pinned in tests/assets/stocks/test_v5_family_cashintensity.py so an accidental sign flip is a test failure, not a result.

3. PIT availability semantics (filed-date end-of-UTC-day stamps + conditioning-lag rule) -> research/assets/stocks/pit_conditioning.py session_gate_utc/usable_for_session/conditioning_panel with max_filing_gap_days = 400; regression-pinned by tests/assets/stocks/test_pit_conditioning_adoption.py (existing) + family mutation tests in tests/assets/stocks/test_v5_family_cashintensity.py (any record with a later availability stamp must be invisible; stale-vintage read must fail).

4. Single-vintage per-field aggregation, ratio-of-means construction, coverage reporting, survivorship via the filing-clock rule -> bridge aggregate_sector_asof + SectorObservation.coverage; frozen eligibility gates (census floor 0.80 with XLF's cash failure enforced; coverage >= 0.60 per field; 100-day effective-date coherence) pinned in tests/assets/stocks/test_v5_family_cashintensity.py with fixture filers that report one field but not the other.

5. Mechanism must not be beta -> net ~ 0 book, frozen kappa_t = clip(trailing-252 OLS beta, 0, 2) risk-matched SPY-context subtraction and [SPY, EW_SECTOR] intercept neutralization -> research/assets/stocks/factory.py + family arm module; mirrors the V4 factor-alpha suite in tests/assets/stocks/.

6. Mechanism must be intensity, not absolute cash -> preregistered CASHLEVEL-L3S3-63 control with the 0.5 alpha-ratio + expectancy <= 0 falsification rule; control-cannot-equal-anchor pinned as a deterministic rank-arithmetic regression (control key != anchor key at every tick; mean |Spearman| <= 0.40, max <= 0.60 measured on the frozen panels) in tests/assets/stocks/test_v5_family_cashintensity.py - the L7 lesson made into a test.
7. Mechanism robustness across scaling constructions -> cash/current-assets neighbour must carry the same sign on its 9-sector declared rank set -> neighbour arm in the same family module.

8. 9. Cross-sectional robustness -> drop-one ETF and drop-one fold reruns per baseline invariants -> value_book rerun harness, non-vacuity asserted (the dropped symbol must change the book) in tests/assets/stocks/test_v5_family_cashintensity.py.
forbidden_inventory_screen: Checked against every entry of forbidden_family_inventory.json and PLAN_stocks_v5.md Section 1: (1) A4_XSEC_ETF_RELATIVE_MOMENTUM - NOT touched: the ranking key is a SEC-filed aggregate ratio (cash/assets); it contains no price, no return and no relative-strength term. (2) A5-SFV2-TREND-DEFENSIVE - no SMA/EMA/trend element and no vol-target defense: gross is a frozen constant and exposure is never scaled by volatility or drawdown; the 'cash-heavy = defensive' reading is a balance-sheet state, not a market-state filter, and the preregistered direction is AGAINST the defensive sectors. (3) SFV3-A5-IDIO-SHOCK-REVERSAL - no idiosyncratic shock, no residual-return term, no event-conditioned countertrade; the book holds a persistent fundamental state. (4) SFV3-A6-TOM-SETTLE - no calendar-date seasonality; the 63-session clock is a session-count grid on the SPY calendar with per-fold reseed. (5) SFV4-A5-H1-PARTICIPATION-SHIFT and its inversion - no dollar-volume, no fresh/stale volume ratio, no participation term. (6) SFV4-A4-H1-SEMIVARIANCE-SHARE and vol-level inversion - no squared-return, no semivariance, no volatility quantity anywhere in the key; this family is NOT the Section 1.1 vol-level re-entry (reserved for another agent); a conservative measured guard (mean |rho| >= 0.60 vs the V4 vol-level control's feature makes this family ineligible) is declared ex ante in novelty_guards_declared_ex_ante. (7) EQ_S2_A3_F1_PIT_RECON_FLOW - that entry is a paid-sprint market-data PIT reconstruction/flow family (never scored); this proposal reconstructs no market data and uses no flow key at all (the anchor is a level). (8) A5-S2-F1-LENDING-CONSTRAINT-PREMIUM - no securities-lending, borrow or short-interest data of any kind (explicitly rejected as a field family; see fields_not_used_pit). Generic list: no cross-sectional momentum, no standalone trend/defensive rotation, no beta-dressed result (incremental alpha mandatory), no earnings-surprise/analyst/flows/borrow/spread mechanism, no daily-indicator grid, no new accounts/paid data/network fetch. Relaxed-gate rescue (Section 1 item 7): none - this is a new PIT-conditioned mechanism with all Stage-A gates unrelaxed; the XLF exclusion and XLC leg delay are census-certified availability facts declared before any scoring, not gate relaxations.

implementation_estimate.engineer_days: ~3 days: feature module (ratio-of-means + per-field coverage wiring) from the frozen spec (0.5), anchor/neighbour/control arm configs sharing the book engine with A4-H1 (0.75), two-panel effective-date coherence + per-field coverage tests (0.75), control-identifiability + PIT mutation + control-cannot-equal-anchor tests (0.5), drop-one/stress/turnover harness wiring (0.5)
implementation_estimate.risk_notes: (1) ratio-of-means is dominated by large-asset filers inside each sector's mean; this is the DECLARED statistic and is constant across arms - a per-filer-ratio mean is unavailable inside the canonical bridge and is not proposed. (2) per-field vintage skew (cash vintage vs assets vintage effective dates) is handled by the frozen 100-day coherence gate; pinned by fixture filers reporting one field only. (3) XLF's census failure (cash 0.70) is permanent and ex ante; the family never claims a financials result. (4) XLC leg delay to ~2018-09 is an availability rule; XLC filer conditioning is unaffected. (5) kappa_t regression must use arm history through t-1 only (no leakage); pinned by mutation test. (6) all estimates in this proposal are analytic expectations from the frozen spec - no PnL was computed at proposal time, and none may be before selection freeze.
